ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark macro-field across both lobes; high-intensity pixels are limited to discrete, stochastic punctate specks and narrow linear streaks, primarily concentrated on the medial and right lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex dividing the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; significant pixel-level irregularity and jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes, sweeping from the central notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast textured pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white point-features across the central surface areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, unaligned, high-intensity linear segments (rake marks) cutting through the dark background pigmentation, notably on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured anomalies (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips; multiple superficial linear abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Overall pigmentation is nearly solid black, corresponding to a Type 1 fluke classification.
